fieldNotes.truckGate: Both road entrances off Dan Morton Drive are wide, open driveways with no barrier arm or sliding gate. Street View (Jan 2025) shows a tractor freely turning into the west driveway with no checkpoint pinch-point. Perimeter is fenced but road access is uncontrolled.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at either entrance in Street View or satellite imagery. Web research confirms drivers 'check in at the office' for door assignment - check-in is at the building, not a gate booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no controlled truck gate at all (remoteGs requires a gate).
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of two large buildings: 357,000 sq ft main plant (west/center) and 252,000 sq ft toppers building (east), separated by an internal driveway.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on the north faces of both the main building and the east toppers building - two physically distinct dock clusters.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer drop lot on the west side of the property with ~30+ trailers parked in marked rows, separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimate ~60 across both north dock faces; partly obscured by parked trailers in imagery - low confidence, banded 50+.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate aprons at both entrances with ample unused paved width for an express bypass lane.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved yard areas inside the property between road and dock faces give trucks room to queue/stage.

citations.claim: Danone North America's own locations page lists this plant at "3333 Dan Morton Dr. Dallas, TX 75236". Our roster address for this record is "3333 Dan Morton Drive, Dallas, TX 75236", which matches at street level, and the record's coordinates were geocoded from that address.

divestitureCheck.method: Danone's own locations page is its current operating list, so presence on it is positive evidence the plant is still running. Cross-checked against the 2026 restructuring, which named Bridgeton NJ as the closure and named Mount Crawford, Dallas and Jacksonville as receiving its volume.
divestitureCheck.result: present on the current company locations page; not closed or divested

sources.covers: the 2026 Danone North America manufacturing restructuring and the single US plant closure it produced

verification.claimScope: address-level identity from the operator's own published facility list, plus a geocode of that address. Not an independent parcel survey.
verification.rationale: CONFIRMED: Danone North America publishes this plant on its own locations page with a full street address, and that address matches this record's roster address at street level. The record's coordinates were geocoded from that same address. Identity is therefore address-level from the operator itself; it is not an independent parcel survey. The same page is the operating-status check: it is Danone's current facility list, and the only one of our 13 published Danone sites missing from it is Bridgeton NJ, which Danone closed on 2026-08-02.
